snippet.title: Cybattler (Arcade/Jaleco/1993 Longplay) [HD]
snippet.description:
http://www.youtube.com/user/MartinKiller88/videos
Check my other longplays (mostly in HD quality) on my channel. If you really liked my videos, don't forget to subscribe.

Cybattler is a 1993 released vertical shmup by Jaleco, released solely for the Arcades. Game is very hard, while first two levels won't give you much problems, next levels surely will. Opposite to classic vertical shmups, our protagonist in the direction we move - it's a drawback in a lot of situations, especially when we are swarmed. Primary weapons are switched between the levels but your plasma sword will be always with you - deals extremely high damage but of course you must be close to the enemy. Because of the high difficulty and restarting level from scratch when losing a coin, I had to use infinite lives cheat here.
